description: Search iNaturalist's record of wildlife sightings - hundreds of millions of them, from every country - by species, place, date or observer. Ask what lives in a park, when a species is about, who records and identifies the most, and read any sighting with its photographs and its discussion. With an API token you can also record sightings, comment, identify, and ask the computer-vision model what is in a photograph. Every search action works without one.
